title: Metric readings of one company, the input of thesis-ci evaluate (SPEC 4.5)

as_of.description: The date the readings were taken

metric.description: A metric id of spec/metrics.yml, a test's metric or metric_def.id, <metric>.<component>, or the id of a test whose op: event sub-rule names no metric

period.description: The fiscal period the value measures: FY<year>, FY<year>H<half> or FY<year>Q<quarter>

value.description: A number; true or false for an event; null when the metric was checked and there is nothing to measure (no qualifying event, or not computed by its definition), with the reason in note. A reading that could not be found is left out, never written as null.

unit.description: %, pp, x, a currency code with an optional scale (USD, USD million, RMB 100 million), shares, event, ...

basis.description: How the value was measured (definition, basis, formula with its inputs)

segment.description: The segment measured; a test with params.segment uses only readings with the same segment, and a test without it only readings without one

series.description: One of several parallel series of the same metric (for example one holder group of params.holders); a sub-rule holds when it holds for any series
